description: codex-scholar discovery server config. NON-SECRET defaults only. SECRETS + personal contact go in ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES, never in this committed file.

env.CODEX_SCHOLAR_MAILTO: your email, opts into OpenAlex's faster 'polite pool' (also passable via -Mailto). Optional but recommended.
env.SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY: PLACEHOLDER — optional Semantic Scholar API key. Unset = keyless shared pool (heavily rate-limited, ~1 req/s, frequent 429s). Set it once you have a key to lift the limits (the adapter tightens its interval automatically). Get one at https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api.
